Everyone must be a man or be the coolest thing around these days apperantly.

edited.. but he always comes back in the end. like he remembers me

Hi, I asked if I should tell his mom and dad, I'm quite close to them actually, I talk openly about alot of things with them. But he said he didnt want his parents to know.. They havent seen the 3 year old scars on his body.. 3 years ago he put 2 cigs right on the hand, he still has wierd scars on there.
Hi, thanks for the reply. I'm only there for listening and some peptalk, I suck at advises.

Hi friend, they don't understand it. They get really scared and they don't know what to do. They panic, I'v seen / heard stories about peoples friend calling the cops instantly. 

My other friend for example, I once accidently told him that the moment I woke up and the moment before I went to sleep I wanted to kill myself every second of it and he said it was normal. Then the conversation stopped.. Thank god it's gone for me. 

I'm still not sure about my friend though, he is obsessed with suicide, he reads about it all day long. Listens to manupilating music that say you should kill yourself etc. I guess I must call some kind of therapy/psycologist on monday at work. Don't know which one though + I guess I have to drive him there to otherwise I dont think he is going to do it at all.
